BAYELSA (PSI 9.5): Gov. Diri presented the ₦1.24trn 2027 Appropriation Bill with 68% capital allocation, flagged off Yenegwe fish harvest, and approved the Igbogene-Yenegwe road.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 9.2): Gov. Umo Eno charged 4,000 newly recruited civil servants during orientation with ₦50k transport support and hosted Pastor Ashimolowo for a 31-LGA medical crusade.
LAGOS (PSI 9.1): Gov. Sanwo-Olu met Google executives on AI maternal health tracking, backed NIPSS for the Orange Economy Summit, and announced plans for a Medical Sciences University.
EDO (PSI 8.9): Edo partnered with the CBN to digitalize state fiscal reporting, while EDOHERMA sealed defiant health facilities and enforced 2026 facility revalidation.
EKITI (PSI 8.7): Gov. Oyebanji appointed 10 Special Advisers across e-GIS, Procurement, and Budget, while Assembly confirmed Attorney-General, Finance, and Health Commissioners.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.7): Gov. Lawal flagged off Kwatar Kwashi–Mada and Tashar Abu road reconstructions, while Health Ministry validated a ₦165bn 2027 Operational Plan.
OGUN (PSI 8.6): Gov. Abiodun highlighted investment traction including the $7bn Gateway Deep Sea Port and $10bn LNG project during the 2027–2029 MTEF Town Hall in Ijebu-Ode.
NIGER (PSI 8.5): Farmer Gov. Umaru Bago received National MSME Award winner Saudatu Mu'azu, backing a 6,433-entrepreneur export drive for 100 'Made in Niger' products.
KADUNA (PSI 8.3): Kaduna LG Service Board began 2026 monitoring in Igabi LGA, donating training reference libraries and reviewing local government worker welfare.
TARABA (PSI 8.3): Gov. Agbu Kefas visited 10 Division Garrison Headquarters in Jalingo to strengthen civil-military intelligence sharing and safeguard border communities.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.2): Adamawa Pilgrims Commission allocated 2027 Hajj seats across 21 LGAs enforcing NUSUK MASAR payments, while Energy Commissioner presented appointment letters to aides.
KANO (PSI 8.2): Kano State executive represented Gov. Yusuf at Tudun Wada/Doguwa constituency empowerment, distributing tractors, vehicles, and sewing machines.
ANAMBRA (PSI 8.1): Gov. Soludo declared open the 99th PSN National Conference in Awka, demanding stricter criminal penalties for fake drug manufacturers.
EBONYI (PSI 8.0): Gov. Nwifuru swore in members of the Ebonyi Public Complaints Commission Board and a Special Adviser on Works to enhance ombudsman and project oversight.
ENUGU (PSI 7.9): NBS figures showed Enugu State generated 87.33% of its ₦406.77bn IGR from non-tax sources in 2025, recording the lowest tax reliance in Nigeria.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.8): Gov. Abdullahi Sule hosted former Chief of Defence Staff Gen. Martin Luther Agwai (rtd) to review his book on international Darfur peacekeeping operations.
